description: Engine-level configuration, domain-agnostic. Values here shape how evidence is weighted everywhere, so changes belong in DECISIONS.md.

catalyst_status_weights._comment: How much a development at each status may contribute to forward supply and infrastructure scoring. A rumour must never count like a funded project (master prompt sections 31 and 56). These are deliberately steep: resort development pipelines are full of announcements that never break ground.

reliability_tier_confidence._comment: Default confidence implied by a source's tier, before source-specific adjustment.

price_change_materiality_bands._comment: Percentage move thresholds for classifying a price change. Conservative because thin markets carry routine small adjustments.

citation_rules._comment: A source that has been identified but not retrieved cannot be cited. Community and anecdotal sources are admissible as OPINION but never alone for a material investment claim.

collection_ethics._comment: Absence of a check is not permission. Sources prohibiting automated access are not crawled; the blocker is recorded and an alternative sought.
